title: Teal Lib
description: A library mod that's teal... That's the appeal
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d4ffd36d191a4b93bbb2792ba3691741ae7eb09c.png)

Library mod I made that provides some common utils for the development of my mods, as well as generally shared code among them.
It also features:
- A new Animation system based on the Vanilla Keyframes
- Fully data driven Variant system for Entities and Block entities
- A new Variant Data registry type that's used by the data driven Variant system to give further customization over the mob variants
- An easy way to store and release mobs from items
- A specific color.
- More!!
